scope: All files packaged under bokeh_sampledata/_data. Paths are relative to that directory.

statuses.source-verified: Publisher terms were inspected. This does not imply a byte-for-byte match to the current upstream data or verified acquisition-time terms.
statuses.embedded-notice: The packaged file itself supplies its notice.
statuses.existing-notice: Existing Bokeh license declaration accepted unless contrary evidence was found. No independent recovery of the original acquisition notice is required for this audit.
statuses.maintainer-confirmed: Source and terms confirmed directly by the maintainer who obtained the data.
statuses.original-bokeh-data: Original assets created for Bokeh under BSD-3-Clause. Generation method and input provenance are recorded in the inventory.

datasets.recorded_license: Public domain (OurAirports records and U.S. government BTS compilation)
datasets.attribution: OurAirports contributors for airport locations. U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics, Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance, July 2026, for flight records.
datasets.notes: Derived distinct reporting operating-carrier/origin/destination combinations from completed, non-diverted flights observed at least four times in July 2026. Carrier codes represent reporting operating carriers, with DOT carrier identifiers. Airport records use OurAirports IDs, not old OpenFlights IDs. BTS PBI is matched to the same airport labeled DJT in the OurAirports snapshot. Keep the 502 prior OurAirports airports plus 12 newly required endpoints, including territories. Some airports have no routes in this month. Not a schedule or complete airline network. Public-domain status is recorded directly, with source credit retained.
datasets.verified_source_terms: Public domain (OurAirports records and U.S. government BTS compilation)

datasets.attribution: Wikidata contributors.
datasets.notes: Wikidata snapshot retrieved 2026-10-18. Contains 17,472 films, publication years 1940-2014, in the full legacy omdb/tomatoes schemas. Values are supplied by Wikidata. IMDb ratings/votes, user scores/counts, editorial Consensus, images, DVD dates and websites are NULL where no source is available. No synthetic metrics or editorial review text are included. Fresh/Rotten are approximate counts derived from rounded Tomatometer percentages. BoxOffice is maximum reported USD gross, often worldwide, with geographic scope varying by source statement. Oscar category counts can be incomplete. Missing filterable text is empty string for compatibility.
datasets.verified_source_terms: Wikidata structured data is available under CC0-1.0.
datasets.selection: Films with IMDb identifiers, publication dates 1940-2014 and Rotten Tomatoes score statements. Include animated, documentary and feature-film subclasses. English labels fall back to multilingual labels.
datasets.transformation: Select the latest available score for each scoring method, ordered by statement date and then review count. Convert scores to the legacy scales. Derive approximate Fresh and Rotten counts from the review count and rounded Tomatometer percentage. Use the maximum reported USD box-office gross per film. Count distinct recorded Academy Award categories from film statements and statements qualified as awards for that work. Retain all legacy columns. Missing filterable text is an empty string and other unavailable values are NULL.

datasets.attribution: Quandl WIKI Prices. Archived copy supplied by marketneutral on Kaggle.
datasets.notes: Historical prices supplied as is by the source, without an independent accuracy guarantee. Extract the original Bokeh date ranges through 2013-03-01 from the WIKI_PRICES.csv archive. Preserve unadjusted open, high, low, close and volume, and the source adjusted close. Convert integral volume to integer and sort chronologically. WIKI GOOGL supplies the pre-2014 Google history exposed as the legacy GOOG dictionary. All original trading dates and row counts are preserved. Adjusted close reflects the archived source snapshot, including corporate actions after the selected dates, rather than the former 2013 export. Store all five series in one gzip CSV with a legacy ticker column.
datasets.verified_source_terms: The archived Quandl publisher page declares the WIKI data public domain and explicitly permits copying, distribution and inclusion in commercial or noncommercial products.
